description_en: Query asset statistics by specified aggregation dimensions
description_zh: 按照指定的聚合维度去查询资产的统计信息
name: DescribeGroupedInstances

parameters.help_en:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The type of assets to query. Fixed value: ecs, indicating Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的资产的类型。固定取值：ecs，表示云服务器
parameters.name: machine_types

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition for querying assets. Valid values:

groupId: queries assets by group.
regionId: queries assets by region.
vpcInstanceId: queries assets by Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
查询资产的过滤条件。取值：

groupId：表示按照资产的分组查询。
regionId：表示按照资产所在的地域查询。
vpcInstanceId：表示按照资产所属的专有网络VPC查询
parameters.name: group_field

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset group to query. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的资产分组的名称，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: field_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable paginated queries. Default value: true. Valid values:
true: enables paginated queries.
false: disables paginated queries
parameters.help_zh:
设置是否启用分页查询。默认值为true。取值：
true：启用分页查询。
false：不启用分页查询
parameters.name: no_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: 20, indicating that 20 entries of asset information are displayed per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的资产信息的数量。  默认值为20，表示每页显示20条资产信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number from which query results start to be displayed. Default value: 1, indicating that query results are displayed starting from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The server vendor. Valid values:

0: Alibaba Cloud assets
1: non-cloud assets
2: IDC assets
3, 4, 5, 7: assets from other cloud providers
8: lightweight assets
parameters.help_zh:
服务器厂商。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en:
The server vendors. Separate multiple vendors with commas (,). Valid values:

0: Alibaba Cloud assets
1: non-cloud assets
2: IDC assets
3, 4, 5, 7: assets from other cloud providers
8: lightweight assets
parameters.help_zh:
服务器厂商。多个厂商使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产
parameters.name: vendors

parameters.help_en:
The edition filter for querying assets. Valid values:

sas_gte_advanced: Advanced edition or higher
sas_gte_enterprise: Enterprise edition or higher
sas_gt_basic: paid editions
sas_eq_advanced: Advanced edition only
sas_gt_anti_virus: editions higher than Anti-virus edition
parameters.help_zh:
查询资产的售卖条件过滤。取值：

sas_gte_advanced：大于等于高级版
sas_gte_enterprise：大于等于企业版
sas_gt_basic：付费版
sas_eq_advanced：等于高级版
sas_gt_anti_virus：大于防病毒版
parameters.name: sale_version_check_code

Instances.description_en: The list of asset information returned
Instances.description_zh: 查询到的资产信息的列表

AsapVulInstanceCount.description_en: The number of assets that have high-severity vulnerabilities
AsapVulInstanceCount.description_zh: 存在高危漏洞的资产的数量

AuthVersionCheckCount.description_en: The number of assets that meet the edition requirements
AuthVersionCheckCount.description_zh: 符合售卖条件的资产数量

FieldAliasName.description_en: The name of the server group

GroupFlag.description_en:
The type of the server group. Valid values:
0: the default group
1: other groups
GroupFlag.description_zh:
服务器分组类型。取值：
0：默认分组
1：其他分组

InstanceCoreCount.description_en:
The total number of compute cores of all assets of the specified asset type.

If the MachineTypes request parameter is not set, the value of this parameter is the total number of compute cores of assets of all types
InstanceCoreCount.description_zh:
查询时指定的资产类型下所有资产的计算核数。

如果未设置请求参数MachineTypes，则该参数返回值为您所有类型的资产的计算核数

InstanceCount.description_en:
The total number of assets of the specified asset type.

If the MachineTypes request parameter is not set, the value of this parameter is the total number of assets of all types
InstanceCount.description_zh:
查询时指定的资产类型下所有资产的数量。

如果未设置请求参数MachineTypes，则该参数返回值为您所有类型的资产的总数量

Os.description_en:
The operating system type of the asset. Valid values:
windows
linux
<notice>This field is returned only when Lang is set to zh.></notice>
Os.description_zh:
资产系统类型。取值：
windows
linux
<notice>该字段仅在Lang为zh时返回。></notice>

RiskInstanceCount.description_en: The number of assets that have security risks
RiskInstanceCount.description_zh: 存在安全风险的资产数量

UnProtectedInstanceCount.description_en: The number of assets that are not protected by Security Center
UnProtectedInstanceCount.description_zh: 未受到云安全中心防护的资产的数量

PageInfo.description_en: The pagination information of the query result

Count.description_en: The number of asset entries displayed on the current page in a paginated query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页面显示的资产的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paginated query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: 20, indicating that 20 entries of asset information are displayed per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的资产信息的数量。  默认值为20，表示每页显示20条资产信息

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of asset entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的资产信息的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
